author: Reshif
body:
As a disclaimer, I asked around and the Avicus discord and was told that submitting an existing map that was not already in the Avicus repository would not be against the rules of the contest.

As I was talking in the Avicus discord, I asked what the purpose of this contest was and what sort of CTW maps were good by Avicus standards, and I was told that there weren't really any established Avicus CTW maps, and this contest was supposedly meant to introduce the gamemode by bringing in more maps.  Very recently I recorded a video where I talk about the history and development of CTW through the past five and a half years, and if anyone here on Avicus is looking to revitalize CTW by emulating the style of maps previously played on Overcast, it may be relevant to understand how that style came to be: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_CXKbzwYcGs

Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/6y88faog4jfu5ox/GD3_revamp.zip?dl=0
I don't have the time to learn YML for one map, so unfortunately I'm going to have to hope that someone else does it for me.

replies.author: Reshif
replies.body:
The middle islands were changed to account for improved staircasing techniques and the communal skybridge issue in competitive.  There were some minor changes to the defense lanes, and all the pistons were made to orient themselves correctly as an update along the way broke piston:6.

If you guys have XML here then you might be able to base it off the existing XML for this map if it's not too different from PGM: https://github.com/OvercastNetwork/maps.oc.tc/blob/master/CTW/Standard/Golden%20Drought%20III/map.xm...
